envelope.description: Add the artifact write inventory and the bypass test

body.title: Add the artifact write inventory and the bypass test
body.summary: Add ARTIFACT_WRITE_INVENTORY (class and via per file; mixed entries name each site and its kind) and the artifact-write-inventory test with a detector that follows direct calls, aliases and injected writers (default parameters and object properties such as write: writeAtomic), with negative and positive controls. Classify every current write site as the LLD states: content, meta-only, mixed, render, record (amendments/store.ts only), migration.
acceptanceChecks: Every production file that calls or passes writeArtifact, writeAtomic, writeFileSync or renameSync has an entry, and a fully migrated file keeps a valid entry.
The detector flags raw writeFileSync, an unannotated raw writeAtomic, 'write: writeAtomic', an alias and a passed writer when none has an entry, and accepts the positive controls.
The classification matches the LLD, including the two code-review files and test-record.ts as content and amendments/store.ts as record.
